notes: Original app SVG geometry and source-evaluated motion. Gallery repetition and its pause/play control are presentation affordances, not the app idle schedule.
motion_extraction: Original Swift HomePoodleMotion executed at 24fps. Source geometry, frames and easing are unchanged. The gallery loops action-specific windows at original speed with short gaps: seated/resting 8.4s, ears/paw/tail 2.7s, head 1.65s, blink 1.5s starting at source 4.8s, yawn 3.9s. Autoplay starts on load; pause/play is manual. Offscreen or hidden galleries suspend and resume without resetting.
